purpose: Define bounded caching of authorization decisions keyed to exact subject/session/assurance/operation/resource/policy revision/context constraints.

topics.name: Authorization Decision Cache
topics.purpose: Define bounded caching of authorization decisions keyed to exact subject/session/assurance/operation/resource/policy revision/context constraints.

semantics.key_rule: Cache key contains all policy-material decision inputs required by profile.
semantics.policy_rule: Cache entry binds exact policy revision/evaluator snapshot.
semantics.resource_rule: Decision cannot be reused for a different resource/operation.
semantics.authority_rule: Cache is optimization evidence and never an independent source of authority.
semantics.fallback_rule: Stale/unresolved cache entry triggers fresh evaluation or deny.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

hard_gates.condition: cached allow reused for different target

references.purpose: Cache stores exact scoped decisions only.
